text:
43세 남성, severe acute pancreatitis 및 SIRS로 입원함.

BP 92/58 mmHg, HR 126 bpm, RR 28 breaths/min, BT 38.5°C, SpO2 95% (room air).

Severe abdominal pain 호소함.

Morphine 4 mg IV q4h 적용함.

IV fluid resuscitation 유지함.

Negative fluid balance 500 mL (last 24 hours) 확인됨.

임상 상태: drowsy.

GI specialist consult 위해 담당의 notify함.
